insights.text: Ronnie built UTV's early television content on a cost-plus B2B model because it lacked funding, then moved into broadcasting and film to own a consumer brand and scale.

insights.text: An integrated media business can create more value than a single-format media company, even when investors criticize its apparent lack of focus.

insights.text: For working adults learning online, the learning experience and process matter more than lectures alone.
insights.speaker: Ronnie Screwvala

insights.text: Opening accessible libraries in rural schools coincided with a sharp rise in attendance, showing that a small change in access can change engagement.

insights.text: Competitive exam preparation is a tournament business: learners pay for coaching because qualifying for scarce places can change their lives.

insights.text: An AI learning app could generate lessons and questions at each student's level and use positive reinforcement to keep them engaged.

stories.lesson: A new channel may require several failures before its strategic value appears.

stories.lesson: Operational experience can ground later leadership decisions.

stories.speaker: Kumar Mangalam Birla
stories.lesson: Scholarships can alter the choices created by unequal household resources.
